================================================================================
Continuation-only follower remains available after a keyword
================================================================================
!is#other
---
(program (keyword) (word))

================================================================================
Whitespace after the continuation-only follower
================================================================================
!is# other
---
(program (keyword) (word))

================================================================================
Same spelling stays a whole word in a word-valid state
================================================================================
is#other
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Separate keyword follower
================================================================================
?is do other
---
(program (keyword) (word))

================================================================================
Keyword follower must not force a prefix split
:error
================================================================================
?isdo other
---
(program (ERROR (word)) (word))

================================================================================
Required continuation-only follower cannot be omitted
:error
================================================================================
!is other
---
(program (ERROR (keyword)) (word))
